title: Queen  and  Paul Rodgers - Still Burnin

lines.l: I got a pain in my memory that just won't sit right
You might say I'm losing my mind, what a shame, shame, shame
But I don't want and I don't need to play the crying game
And it won't let me be
And I, oh, I can't leave it
Here we are, rock'n'roll never dies
I can't breathe in the city, the dust in my lungs
I get mad in the country, everything seems to go wrong
You might think I'm playing around, but my part is true
I got a reason to believe that sweet soul's magic
Gonna tear my heart in two
Music makes the world go around
I've been flying on the wings of the sound
It feels so good from the way up here
Don't say that you love me
But don't think for a moment
I keep thinking about what I lost
And what I might have found
I went to sleep in the winter road
Still turning, in the new day tour
We're driving, still driving, skydiving, only in the fall, still burning, still yearning, still turning, matters are never kind, we're driving, still driving, skydiving, rock and roll never die.
